messages.subject: legends-ggplot2
parts:
Hi,


I have the following code which produces two regression lines, one is broken and one is solid line. I want to produce 
two legend lines of the same type and to add names to each legend line. I would prefer if legends are within the plot. 

Can someone help me with this? 



Thank you very much!!!


Nicholas


   genesone = data.frame(cbind(human_gene_gc,human_ds_gene))
   genestwo = data.frame(cbind(human_gene_gc,human_dn_pseudo))

   
ploth<-  ggplot() +

   geom_point(data=genesone,aes(human_gene_gc,human_ds_gene),color="#404040",alpha=0)+  
   geom_smooth(aes(human_gene_gc,human_ds_gene),colour="#000000", lwd=0.4, method=lm, formula = y ~ x + I(x ^2), se=TRUE) + 

  
  geom_point(data=genestwo,aes(human_gene_gc,human_ds_pseudo), colour="#404040",alpha=0) +
  geom_smooth(aes(human_gene_gc,human_ds_pseudo),colour="#404040",lwd=0.4, lty=2, method=loess, formula = y ~ x, se=TRUE)+ 
  
  

  ggtitle("human") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("") +
   
 
   theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank())

messages.subject: Re: legends-ggplot2
parts:
See the post titled "add extra legend" which was the last thread on
the list, and is basically exactly the same problem that you're
having.

Hadley

PS. It's a really bad idea to do data.frame(cbind(a, b)), just do
data.frame(a, b)
PPS. You will get more helpful advice if you include a minimal
reproducible example
